gatewayPage.gotchaBody: Telegram: a 'chat_id' from @userinfobot is your private DM. Group chats use a negative id (open the group and use @userinfobot inside it). Leave chat_id blank to accept any chat. WeChat / Feishu / WeCom / DingTalk: configure the receiver in the platform's admin console (App ID + Secret for Feishu/WeCom; webhook URL for DingTalk's group robot). Once saved, watch /gateway → Live status while you send a test message: every drop now surfaces a hint here.
